shape.branchOffIntermediate: This branch starts from an intermediate result; layers always start at the source.
shape.notAStack: This wiring cannot be written as a layer stack.
shape.noImageSource: The graph has no image source a photo could come from.
shape.severalImageSources: The graph has more than one image source; a photo has exactly one.
shape.maskNotASource: This mask input does not come from a mask; classically every layer has exactly one.
shape.missingInput: This node has no input; the chain is broken.
shape.cycle: This node sits in a cycle; a layer chain always runs one way.

chain.noClassicEquivalent: {{kind}} has no equivalent in the classic view.
chain.wrongOrder: {{earlierKind}} comes before {{laterKind}}; the classic view has a fixed order.
chain.duplicateKind: {{kind}} occurs twice in a row; classically there is only one per layer.
chain.baseStageKind: {{kind}} is not part of the camera profile's base development.

param.branchDiffers: Parameter "{{field}}" differs between the branches; classically it applies to the whole image.
param.cameraMetadata: Parameter "{{field}}" classically comes from the camera metadata and cannot be set there.
param.lensProfileUnknown: This lens correction matches no known profile; classically only a profile can be picked.
param.baseStageEdited: This base development comes from the camera profile and cannot be set classically.
param.spaceOverrideAsymmetric: This node reads and writes in different color spaces; classically there is only one switch for that.
param.spaceOverrideConflict: The color space switches of the HSL nodes contradict each other; classically one applies to all three.

document.maskWithoutShape: This layer has a mask with no classic mask shape to go with it.
document.customHslSplit: The color ranges cannot be split across the three lists of the classic view.
